name: DropdownMenu
summary: Menu of actions triggered by a control.

a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 22/08/2026 (tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts), not read off the APG. ArrowUp opens the menu with focus on the LAST item and Space opens it with focus on the first — both were missing from this ficha, and both are how the engine behaves. The measured evidence is aria-expanded=true plus focus landing on a .menu-item.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens the menu. Usually a Button or an IconButton.

props.name: items
props.description: The menu, as data: {label, onClick?, disabled?, leadingIcon?}. The literal string "separator" draws a rule — a separator is not an item, so it never takes focus.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side; it flips when there is no room.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the menu itself. Worth setting when a page has more than one — otherwise a screen reader lists several menus with nothing to tell them apart.
